Synthetic post with a code block

This is a hand-written synthetic article used only for tests. It explains a tiny function and then shows the code in a fenced block, so that the Markdown conversion can be checked for fenced code output.

The function below adds two numbers. It is deliberately trivial; the point of the fixture is the structure of the page, not the content of the code itself.

function add(a, b) {
  return a + b;
}
console.log(add(1, 2));

After the code block there is one more paragraph, which keeps the article long enough to be treated as a full article rather than a bookmark.
